purpose: Machine-readable alignment of Course 1 lesson-level knowledge checks, cumulative module assessments, course final and practical evidence. This map documents the learner runtime that already serves objective-aligned formative items after each lesson while preserving the distinction between formative learning checks and summative or credential decisions.

lessonKnowledgeCheck.label: Lesson Knowledge Check
lessonKnowledgeCheck.purpose: Low-stakes retrieval, application and scenario practice aligned to the lesson learning objective(s), with immediate explanatory feedback.
lessonKnowledgeCheck.itemCountPolicy: Expandable. Use enough reviewed items to test the lesson objective meaningfully; do not impose an artificial maximum item count.
lessonKnowledgeCheck.recommendedActiveDepth: Normally 5-10 reviewed items per lesson as the bank matures, with count driven by objective coverage rather than a fixed ceiling.
lessonKnowledgeCheck.remediation: Missed responses should point learners back to the relevant concept, worked example, visual, scenario or activity and then reassess the idea in a changed context.
lessonKnowledgeCheck.credentialEffect: None by itself. Lesson knowledge checks are formative and do not independently award a course or professional credential.

moduleAssessment.label: Module Assessment
moduleAssessment.purpose: Cumulative formative mastery check across the three lessons in each module.
moduleAssessment.credentialEffect: None by itself. Module results support learning feedback, remediation and readiness for later course-level assessment.

courseFinal.purpose: Course-level summative knowledge assessment across Course 1 objectives.

integratedPractical.purpose: Performance evidence that the learner can integrate safety, controlled work, traceability, equipment boundaries and records in realistic workflow conditions.

architecture.credentialBoundary: Course completion and the Technician I professional credential remain separate decisions. Course 1 completion alone must not be represented as the full Technician I credential.

canonicalLessonFieldPolicy.assessmentField: The lesson object's assessment field may remain null until a dedicated persistent lesson-assessment object is introduced. The runtime knowledge-check relationship is authoritative through this map plus the lesson practice endpoint and objective-aligned question bank.
canonicalLessonFieldPolicy.noDuplicationRule: Do not copy module-bank questions into lesson JSON merely to populate the assessment field. Maintain one governed question source and expose appropriate items through the lesson practice runtime.
canonicalLessonFieldPolicy.futureMigration: When dedicated lesson assessment objects are introduced, populate lesson.assessment with stable assessment IDs and keep this map as the cross-course audit/index layer.
